scope: Finite known-family rejection controls with fresh thermal alternatives, not general missing-physics detection
split_rule: Half the independent pairs at each lag fit a zero-mean unrestricted Gaussian covariance plus fixed ridge; the other half evaluate fitted density over maximum listed-candidate likelihood. Reject family if ratio exceeds 1/family_alpha.
concentration_rule: All pairs, orthogonal sum/difference coordinates. For each candidate compare normalized sums of squares to Laurent-Massart bounds with x=log(4*number_of_lags/family_alpha). Reject the family only if every candidate fails at least one check.
confidence_rule: Full-data fixed uniform-mixture likelihood ratio confidence set at confidence_alpha. Gate replaces it with an empty set when the family is rejected; rejection dominates all point claims.
metrics: mean relative response error of accepted singleton claims
budget_rule: N total independent position pairs, equally divided between lags; two readings per pair; split methods do not receive extra observations
uncertainty: Per-scenario Wilson 95 percent Monte Carlo intervals; pooled stratified results descriptive; common random numbers couple methods and designs
holdout_rule: No alias 4 retest, no tuning after fresh scenario results. Single lag comes from prior development; second lag fixed before this run.
limitations: Known Gaussian stationary pairs and known sensor noise; no overlapping time-series samples, no unknown-function confidence band, no arbitrary stopping
